title: Mailbox/set: create+destroy in same request can destroy newly-parented mailbox
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_set fetches all_mailboxes once BEFORE the create loop. The destroy loop uses this stale snapshot for child-mailbox checks. If a single request creates a child mailbox AND destroys its parent, the destroy child-check will not see the new child (it wasn't in the pre-create snapshot) and the parent will be destroyed. Fix: re-fetch mailboxes (or build an updated list from the create results) before the destroy loop's child check.
